exams.name: Tableau Certified Architect
exams.blurb: Advanced Tableau credential on deploying, scaling, securing and maintaining Tableau Server and Tableau Cloud environments in the enterprise.

exams.name: Tableau Certified Consultant
exams.blurb: Advanced Tableau credential on solution design, complex calculations, performance optimisation and advising organisations on analytics deployments.

exams.name: Tableau Certified Data Analyst
exams.blurb: Mid-level Tableau certification combining knowledge and hands-on lab tasks on data preparation, analysis, dashboard design and content publishing.

exams.name: Tableau Desktop Specialist
exams.blurb: Entry-level Tableau certification covering connecting to data, building basic charts, calculations, dashboards and sharing work; it does not expire.

exams.name: Tableau Server Certified Associate
exams.blurb: Retired Tableau credential on server administration, now replaced by the Certified Architect track but still referenced on many job postings.

exams.name: Adobe Certified Expert - Experience Manager Sites
exams.blurb: Advanced credential for Adobe Experience Manager Sites developers and architects building and managing enterprise web content.

exams.name: Adobe Certified Professional - Illustrator
exams.blurb: Validates vector design skills in Adobe Illustrator including drawing, typography, color and artwork production for visual creators.

exams.name: Adobe Certified Professional - Photoshop
exams.blurb: Entry credential confirming creative and technical proficiency in Adobe Photoshop for design, photo editing and digital imaging.

exams.name: Adobe Certified Professional - Premiere Pro
exams.blurb: Confirms video editing proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro including sequence editing, audio, color and export workflows.

exams.name: Adobe Marketo Engage Professional
exams.blurb: Validates marketing automation skills in Marketo Engage including campaign design, lead management, scoring and nurture programs.

exams.name: ServiceNow Certified Application Developer
exams.blurb: Confirms building applications on ServiceNow using tables, scripting, business rules, UI policies and scoped app development practices.

exams.name: ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist - ITSM
exams.blurb: Validates implementation of ServiceNow IT Service Management, covering incident, problem, change, request and CMDB best practices.

exams.name: ServiceNow Certified Master Architect
exams.blurb: Elite credential for architects who have achieved CTA plus multiple domain specialties and proven leadership across deployments.

exams.name: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator
exams.blurb: Entry credential validating administration of the ServiceNow platform, including users, roles, forms, lists, workflows and baseline config.

exams.name: ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect
exams.blurb: Top-tier architect credential requiring a board review and demonstrating enterprise-scale ServiceNow solution and integration design.

exams.name: Confluent Certified Administrator for Apache Kafka
exams.blurb: Confluent certification on operating Kafka clusters covering broker configuration, replication, security, monitoring, scaling and troubleshooting.

exams.name: Confluent Certified Developer for Apache Flink
exams.blurb: Confluent certification on stream processing with Apache Flink, covering Flink SQL, state management, windowing, watermarks and job deployment.

exams.name: Confluent Certified Developer for Apache Kafka
exams.blurb: Confluent certification for developers building Kafka applications, covering producers, consumers, Kafka Streams, schemas and delivery guarantees.

exams.name: Elastic Certified Analyst
exams.blurb: Hands-on Elastic exam on searching and visualising data in Kibana, building dashboards, using Lens and creating alerts from Elasticsearch data.

exams.name: Elastic Certified Engineer
exams.blurb: Performance-based Elastic exam on building and managing Elasticsearch clusters, covering indexing, mappings, queries, aggregations and cluster health.

exams.name: Elastic Certified Observability Engineer
exams.blurb: Performance-based Elastic exam on ingesting logs, metrics and traces, configuring APM, building service maps and setting up observability alerting.

exams.name: MongoDB Associate Data Modeler
exams.blurb: MongoDB certification on schema design patterns, embedding versus referencing, workload-driven modelling and evolving document schemas.

exams.name: MongoDB Associate Database Administrator
exams.blurb: MongoDB certification on deploying and operating clusters, covering replication, sharding, backup, security, monitoring and performance tuning.

exams.name: MongoDB Associate Developer
exams.blurb: MongoDB certification covering CRUD operations, aggregation, indexes, drivers and building applications against MongoDB using its query language.

exams.name: Qlik Sense Business Analyst Certification
exams.blurb: Qlik certification on gathering requirements, designing applications and building effective visualisations and dashboards in Qlik Sense.

exams.name: Qlik Sense Data Architect Certification
exams.blurb: Qlik certification on data modelling, scripting, connecting sources and transforming and optimising data loads within Qlik Sense applications.

exams.name: Qlik Sense System Administrator Certification
exams.blurb: Qlik certification covering installation, security rules, licensing, node configuration and monitoring of Qlik Sense Enterprise deployments.

exams.name: SAS Certified Data Scientist
exams.blurb: Composite SAS credential earned by completing the Big Data and Advanced Analytics certification tracks covering data wrangling and machine learning.

exams.name: SAS Certified Professional: Advanced Programming Using SAS 9.4
exams.blurb: SAS certification covering SQL processing, macro programming and advanced DATA step techniques for experienced SAS programmers.

exams.name: SAS Certified Specialist: Base Programming Using SAS 9.4
exams.blurb: SAS certification covering DATA step programming, importing and exporting data, combining tables and producing reports with Base SAS.

exams.name: Atlassian Certified - Agile Development with Jira Software
exams.blurb: Validates applying agile practices and Jira Software boards, sprints, reports and backlog refinement for delivery teams.

exams.name: Atlassian Certified Professional - Jira Administrator
exams.blurb: Confirms administration of Jira Software and Jira Service Management, including schemes, permissions, workflows and project config.

exams.name: Atlassian Certified Professional - System Administrator
exams.blurb: Confirms managing Atlassian Cloud organizations including user provisioning, security, guardrails and product administration.

exams.name: NetSuite Certified Administrator
exams.blurb: Confirms administration of NetSuite including setup, customization, workflows, saved searches and user and role management.

exams.name: NetSuite Certified ERP Consultant
exams.blurb: Validates implementing NetSuite ERP, including financials, order management, inventory and implementation best practices.

exams.name: NetSuite Certified SuiteFoundation
exams.blurb: Entry credential validating NetSuite ERP basics including navigation, roles, transactions, records and standard business processes.

exams.name: Alteryx Designer Advanced Certification
exams.blurb: Advanced Alteryx exam covering macros, analytic apps, spatial and predictive tools and optimising complex Designer workflows.

exams.name: Alteryx Designer Core Certification
exams.blurb: Foundational Alteryx exam covering data preparation, blending, parsing, joins and reporting tools within Alteryx Designer workflows.
